doc: Diving rows (M3-AUD-06; assets_src/sfx/underwater_sfx.py): Rhen's dives (Ch1's drowned tower and later dives) and any zone with an UnderwaterRig (M2-RND-02). Same row format as sfx.json; AudioData.sfx_rows merges this file in. Positional on World at the diver. dive_lantern_hum is a seamless loop (it imports with loop on): play it once when the lit lantern goes under and stop the returned player when it comes up. The underwater beds (underwater_deep, drowned_tower) are ambience.json beds. No dive scene exists yet, so these rows wait for one.
